experiment.coordinate_convention: World Cartesian metres for synthetic truth/surveyed maps; estimator joint gauge is separately disclosed in run diagnostics

motion.profile_node_units: fraction of duration, signed relative speed; variable profile normalized by peak forward excursion
motion.endpoint_rule: Position holds at path endpoints and outside [0,duration]; speed is zero while held
motion.height_parameterization: tilted: z=offset+tan(tilt)*(x-5m); excursion: offset+A*sin(2pi*t/T); spatial adds .45A*sin(6pi*t/T+.2); endpoint times hold

acquisition_metadata.grouping_rule: assume every ping in epoch occurs at estimator_input.times_s[epoch]
acquisition_metadata.delivery_latency_rule: delivery_time_s=actual_time_s+latency; never used in batch fitting
acquisition_metadata.range_noise_pairing: fixed Gaussian draw indexed by cycle and beacon, independent of missingness and timing

solver.iterations_note: SciPy reports evaluations, not iteration count

jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale
jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement-only rank after gauge removal; full rank does not prove global uniqueness

augmented_jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale
augmented_jacobian.interpretation: Augmented rank includes physical/model assumptions, not new measurement information

truth_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

fit_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

truth_beacon_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

best_fit_plane.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

height.interpretation: Matched world-z errors after allowed proper alignment; best-fit-plane departure distinguishes tilted planes from warped paths

gauge.description: Surveyed world frame; no gauge freedoms are fitted
gauge.remaining_reflections: Distances permit reflected solutions; no reflection is removed by alignment. In3D, reflection across first-three plane preserves canonical anchors; below bounds may select a branch.
gauge.local_rank_note: After valid gauge removal, measurement rank deficits disclose additional local continuous ambiguities

constraints.separation_note: Below inequalities select a branch; they neither fix a tag plane nor add range measurements

truth_jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale
truth_jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement-only rank after gauge removal; full rank does not prove global uniqueness

truth_augmented_jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale
truth_augmented_jacobian.interpretation: Augmented rank includes physical/model assumptions, not new measurement information

trajectory_model.prior_definition: Time-weighted interior-knot deviation inxyz divided by prior_sigma_m; soft height is a separate prior

truth_interpolation_floor.definition: Truth projected onto gauge and selected height model, then knots/interpolation; combined representation/model mismatch, not optimizer lower bound
truth_interpolation_floor.outside_domain_rule: Endpoint hold only for actual-time evaluation

truth_interpolation_only.definition: Canonical truth sampled at knots and interpolated without imposing tag or beacon height models

truth_model_projection.definition: Selected tag/beacon height models projected at canonical truth knots, before time interpolation

truth_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

truth_beacon_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

diagnostics.surveyed_map_source: Synthetic map explicitly supplied as surveyed knowledge
diagnostics.ambiguity: Distances permit reflected solutions; no reflection is removed by alignment. In3D, reflection across first-three plane preserves canonical anchors; below bounds may select a branch.
